attributes.action: Affordable and comfortable uniforms for ALL primary and secondary schools
attributes.additional_details: I believe all primary and secondary schools should adopt a simple, affordable and inclusive uniform: plain black skirts, shorts, trousers, joggers or leggings, with a polo shirt and school-coloured jumper. This would reduce costs for families, provide comfortable choices for all children, promote inclusion and ensure pupils feel comfortable, confident and ready to learn.
attributes.background: All schools should have a simple, affordable and inclusive uniform: black skirts, shorts, trousers, joggers or leggings, with a polo shirt and school-coloured jumper. This would reduce costs, give children comfortable choices, promote inclusion and help every child feel confident and ready to learn.

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign this open petition calling for similar action:

Update guidance on secondary uniform to support inclusion & comfort
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/779210

The Government does not set guidance for the colour of school uniforms, this decision is made by schools.
